caption: Figure 1: Post-training pipeline of the Qwen3 series models.
description:
Figure type: Diagram showing a pipeline.
Description: The figure illustrates the post-training pipeline for the Qwen3 series models, detailing the stages and processes involved in model development. It starts with base models, progresses through stages of reasoning and fusion, and culminates in the creation of flagship and lightweight models.

Text in figure: Base Models, Long-CoT Cold Start, Reasoning RL, Thinking Mode Fusion, General RL, Qwen3-235B-A22B, Qwen3-32B, Flagship Models, Lightweight Models, Strong-to-Weak Distillation, Qwen3-30B-A3B, 14B/8B/4B/1.7B/0.6B.

caption: Figure 2: Performance of Qwen3-235B-A22B with respect to the thinking budget.
description:
## Description

This figure contains four line plots comparing the performance of Qwen3-235B-A22B in non-thinking mode and thinking mode across different benchmarks. Each plot shows the pass rate (Pass@1) as the thinking budget (in K tokens) increases from 1 to 32. The series for thinking mode is consistently higher than non-thinking mode across all benchmarks.
